blueprint.context: The dispute cannot be settled by tasting, because two tasters disagree. Denet has kept the water-glass in its case for six days. The moment he uses it in public he stops being a passenger, and everyone in the field learns that a sealed instrument can say in a minute what a board takes on faith.
objectives: Stage the argument as one mouth against another mouth, with money on both sides of it
Bring the water-glass out and show exactly how it reads, in front of witnesses
Let Iseul correct 'sealed' to 'chalked' and say nothing else
Make the board wrong in both directions so the count survives and the trust does not
Have Sabra ask what else the glass has been floated against, and let Denet not answer where Ysoly can see it

setting.description: The taster's board and the well field in the ninth hour of the morning; then collar thirty-four and collar fifty-one, with the whole awning stood round a stoneware jar in the glare.

synopsis: Sabra says thirty-four has turned and fifty-one is sweet; Rusk says it is a tongue against nineteen years of chalk. Denet opens the case and floats the College-sealed glass on both. The board is rewritten to the same count and a different nine, and the field goes on ration.
title: Thirty-Four and Fifty-One
